# Spider-Verse Broadcast Leak

## 題目描述

A glitchy Spider-Verse relay keeps re-broadcasting the same packet from Miles. Numbers spill out everywhere, but something about the transmission feels way too orderly.

```json
{
  "ciphertext": "16061189851687597120996926301104657943371254567888802706085341545044609833111279875378049334585413773524402884958140237544824980651257894051011430259274146027654956734324320859907221246501733764510903950738295836450198242955006792630838088633440092969580163361765729135432881536101",
  "e": 3,
  "lore": "The multiversal antenna only trusts perfect cubes.",
  "n": ""
}
```

## 解題思路

題目的模數 `n`：

```text

```

`ciphertext`：

```text
16061189851687597120996926301104657943371254567888802706085341545044609833111279875378049334585413773524402884958140237544824980651257894051011430259274146027654956734324320859907221246501733764510903950738295836450198242955006792630838088633440092969580163361765729135432881536101
```

題目給 `e = 3`，而且 `lore` 提示 `ciphertext` 是完全立方數（perfect cube）。

對 `ciphertext` 取三次方根後，可得 `m^3 == c`，因此可知 `m^3 < n`。也就是說，RSA 的 `mod n` 沒有影響結果；將 `m` 轉回 bytes 後，就能拿到 flag。
